# Three.js 0.186.0 (r186)

Vendored ES modules for the local WebGL knowledge space. No runtime CDN requests.

- Upstream release: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/releases/tag/r186
- `three.module.min.js`: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.186.0/build/three.module.min.js
- `three.core.min.js`: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.186.0/build/three.core.min.js
- MIT license: `LICENSE`, from the upstream r186 tag.

Keep the module/core versions together. Do not remove copyright/license headers.
The module's two relative `./three.core.js` import/export paths are adjusted to
`./three.core.min.js` to match the locally stored core filename. The rest is unmodified.
